id.description: The id the section is found by and, for [`Stored::Config`], the key its values have in `[settings]`: a word of lower-case letters, digits and `_`, 1 to 32.

help.description: A line saying what it holds, shown above its form.

icon.description: The name of one of the application's icons; a name it does not know draws the default.

group.description: The heading it sits under in the list of sections, for a section of its own; [`DEFAULT_GROUP`] when none.

under.description: The id of an existing section this is a group in, instead of a section of its own.

keywords.description: Words the search over Settings finds it by, besides its title.

x-enum-labels.config: In the table `[settings.ID]` of the host's canoa.cfg, which the host writes after checking the values against the schema.
x-enum-labels.provider: With the provider: the host calls [`SettingsSection::read`] and [`SettingsSection::write`].

schema.description: The values it takes, as a guatiao schema of an object whose members are what its form asks for. A member the schema marks sensitive is never answered in clear.

form.description: How the schema is shown, a guatiao-intake form document; none shows the form the schema implies.

list.description: The control method that lists the rows and kinds, `SERVICE/METHOD`.

add.description: The control method that adds a row.

remove.description: The control method that takes a row away.

test.description: The control method that checks a row, when it has one.

items.description: The member of `list`'s answer that holds the rows.

kinds.description: The member of `list`'s answer that holds the kinds.

kind_member.description: The member of a row, and of `add`'s parameters, that names its kind.

add_label.description: What the button that adds a row says; the application's own word when none.

empty.description: What the list says when it has no row.

empty_help.description: What the list says under that, to explain what is missing.

kind_label.description: What the field that picks a kind is called.

test_label.description: What the button that checks a row says; the application's own word when none.

remove_note.description: What taking a row away does, said when the person is asked to confirm.

collection.description: A list of rows the section manages through a service's control methods, drawn above its form.

x-enum-labels.config: In the table `[settings.ID]` of the host's canoa.cfg, which the host writes after checking the values against the schema.
x-enum-labels.provider: With the provider: the host calls [`SettingsSection::read`] and [`SettingsSection::write`].
